<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/plugin-api/remote-desktop/connect-host/{hostId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Resolves the host's RDP, VNC, ARD or Telnet login for the caller (a shared recipient gets only what was shared with them), opens a jump tunnel when the host has jump hosts, and returns an encrypted guacamole-lite token.

<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"in":"path","name":"hostId","required":true,"schema":{"type":"integer"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"protocol":{"type":"string","enum":["rdp","vnc","ard","telnet"]},"promptedUsername":{"type":"string"},"promptedPassword":{"type":"string"},"promptedDomain":{"type":"string"},"tabInstanceId":{"type":"string"}}}}}}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>

<StatusCodes
  responses={{"200":{"description":"The token and the id to look the session up by."},"400":{"description":"Invalid host id, or the protocol is off for this host."},"403":{"description":"Remote Desktop is turned off."},"404":{"description":"Host not found or no access."},"500":{"description":"The tunnel or the token could not be set up."}}}
>
  
</StatusCodes>
